# Find the index of the column with the target header
headers = [cell.value for cell in ws[1]]
try:
    col_idx = headers.index(target_header) + 1 # 1-based index for openpyxl
except ValueError:
    col_idx = None

if col_idx:
    count = 0
    # Iterate through the data rows (starting from row 2)
